description:
## Finding
The four \"planned\" crates (\`pkix-revocation-http\`, \`pkix-ct\`, \`pkix-composite\`, \`pkix-ac\`) carry version 0.1.1 in their Cargo.toml but the actual public functions are stubs marked \`#[deprecated = \"... not yet implemented; this function always returns ...\"]\`. Examples:
- \`pkix-ct/src/lib.rs:104\` \`pub fn verify_scts\` returns \`Err(NoTrustedSct)\` unconditionally
- \`pkix-ac/src/lib.rs:120\` \`pub fn validate_attribute_cert\` returns hardcoded \`Err\`
- \`pkix-composite/src/lib.rs:64\` \`CompositeVerifier::new\` is itself \`#[deprecated]\`
- \`pkix-revocation-http\` has no impl at all of its advertised \`HttpCrlFetcher\` / \`HttpOcspFetcher\`.

The other crates in the workspace are at v0.2.0; the v0.1.1 number on stubs implies an earlier already-published version.

## Why P2
- Section 0 anchor — the workspace README marks them as \"planned\" but the version number suggests \"published, just slightly older.\" If anyone has \`pkix-ct = \"0.1\"\` in Cargo.toml, they get a stub that returns Err on every call and warns on every use.
- A v0.1.1 release with \`#[deprecated]\` on its only public function is an unusual semver shape. Better practice: either publish as 0.0.x (clearly pre-release) or do not publish at all until the implementation lands.
- Either Mark cut these crates to reserve names on crates.io (legitimate but should be documented), or the version was bumped without justification.

## Fix
Pick one and document the rationale:
1. Drop these crates from the workspace until ready (delete dirs, remove from members list).
2. Bump version to 0.0.0 (or 0.0.1) to signal \"unreleased / placeholder\".
3. If 0.1.1 is intentional name-reservation, add a clear note in each crate-level lib.rs and README explaining the version mechanics.

Side note: \`pkix-revocation-http\` lib.rs imports types from \`pkix-revocation\` but does not depend on its \`crl\`/\`ocsp\` features for the delegation. Once implementation begins this Cargo.toml will need feature-flag wiring.

## Scope reference
\`pkix-revocation-http/Cargo.toml:5\`, \`pkix-ct/Cargo.toml:5\`, \`pkix-composite/Cargo.toml:5\`, \`pkix-ac/Cargo.toml:5\`. Workspace \`Cargo.toml:30,33,34,35\` references.
title: P2: stub crates published as v0.1.1 with #[deprecated] - confusing semver state
